expected: Root never releases; ownership preserved and resume requires a fresh deliberate arm action.

title: Root postrelease persistence
steps: Commit release; die during escape, force-close during event and reload every supported saved phase.
expected: Anja is not resurrected; no repeated goodbye required; escape starts from coherent safe postrelease state.

title: Cohort uniqueness
steps: Visit every release/route/Ward/evacuation phase while streaming both directions.
expected: Exactly twelve stable slots; no duplicated live presentation; all intended survivors reach final exit.

title: Water/bell restore
steps: Save at lower/moving/upper bell poses with different breath values and restart.
expected: Head-air test, pocket, hose, water level and bell q agree on first visible frame.

title: Thin versus thick cloth
steps: Cross search view behind each cloth class at low/high graphics and captions-only sound.
expected: Sight rules and silhouette evidence remain consistent; no detection through defined opaque cover.

title: Ward support recovery
steps: Interrupt every support edge and crouch stage; try reverse input and hold during support transfer.
expected: Rig remains on valid contacts or recovers to last stable pose; no impossible foot snap or uncontrolled fall.

title: Moving-platform controller
steps: Run/jump/turn on translating and rotating platforms and replay at varied render rates.
expected: No frame-rate-dependent carry drift, unintended double velocity or clipped landing.

title: Save interrupted writes
steps: Interrupt file write, fill disk, remove write permission and corrupt current save copy in test environment.
expected: Previous valid generation recoverable; errors legible; no silent new game or settings loss.

title: Streaming owner pinning
steps: Hold and transfer across chunk boundaries; reverse quickly; test cold disk.
expected: Owner/target chunks remain resident until resolved; no queue deadlock or missing interaction.

title: Input accessibility complete route
steps: Complete representative rooms and finale using toggle Hold/grip, remaps and breath assistance.
expected: Same canonical story and success predicates; no inaccessible simultaneous-input requirement.

title: No-audio critical route
steps: Mute audio and enable captions; play search, breath, Porter and root interactions.
expected: Critical decisions have visual/caption equivalents; no required musical timing.

title: Low-effects readability
steps: Use minimum effects, low brightness within calibrated range and reduced motion.
expected: Contacts, water/head relation, hazards and route still readable; reveal retains meaning.

title: First Step emotional transfer
steps: Fresh players learn carrier/room then reach rough Ward without extra instruction; interview afterward.
expected: Players understand shared controls and mention occupants/responsibility; not solely a funny robot or unrelated vehicle.

title: Story causality
steps: After uninterrupted full run, ask what Hold does, who enforces it, why Anja cannot leave and why release is safe.
expected: Players identify conscious bearers, institutional choice, irreversible root and preparation; origin of technology may remain uncertain.

title: Duration without filler
steps: Record fresh full runs excluding pauses/menus; separate solve, travel, retry and stalled time per sequence.
expected: Median target 210–240 minutes; no correction through forced waits or speed reduction.

title: Performance cold/warm
steps: Capture release-like builds on recorded floor/target fixtures over opening, water and maximum Ward view.
expected: Agreed frame-time/residency budgets pass; no hidden mechanical divergence at lower frame rate.

title: Long-session memory
steps: Loop chapter loads/retries for two hours and perform a full campaign.
expected: Memory stabilizes; no persistent audio voices, pooled debris growth or unreleased streaming handles.

title: Clean distribution run
steps: Install actual distribution package on clean offline machine, play, save, update supported version and continue.
expected: No dev dependency, missing license, broken continue or incorrect build provenance.

title: Opening control and mother
steps: Observe new player from first frame; do not give task hints.
expected: Control begins within opening seconds; relationship and reason to follow Anja are clear before first lethal puzzle.

title: No source-art leakage
steps: Scan shipping package and credits against asset/licensing register.
expected: No reference screenshots, fonts without permitted embedding, unlicensed placeholders or debug captures ship.
